article.story: BINGHAMTON, N.Y. -- — Jeremiah Quigley totaled 18 points and 12 assists, finishing a rebound shy of a triple-double to lead Binghamton to a 75-63 victory over Rider on Sunday. Quigley made 7 of 19 shots and 4 of 6 free throws for the Bearcats (2-1). Dylan Godfrey scored 18 points while shooting 8 for 10, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. Bobby Montgomery Jr. had 13 points and went 6 of 6 from the field. Khalil Farmer led the way for the Broncs (0-3) with 15 points. Rich Brisco and Horace Simmons both scored 12 with Brisco adding a pair of blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
